excerpt.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在脉冲星或中子星周围修建量子弹弓了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船以开始修建。
excerpt.en: Recent advances in mega-engineering research mean we may now construct a Quantum Catapult around a pulsar or neutron star. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.
